recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. No FHIR core follow-up is needed for FHIR-13318 unless OO separately decides to rewrite the broader Observation code/value-pair guidance.
issue_request: Published OO issue FHIR-13318 requested Observation examples for findings, signs, and symptoms, including SNOMED finding concepts in Observation.code with yes/no, true/false, or SNOMED qualifier values in Observation.value[x]. Its persuasive-with-modification resolution also called for language that Observation.code and Observation.value must be considered together rather than making value[x] a modifier.
initial_application: Historical GF#13318 commits applied the request: ded8a0f22a and e0757bde53 partially updated Observation narrative notes in November 2017, and 3beaa4e73f added vomiting and second-hand-smoke examples plus examples-page links in February 2018. Current source carries the same examples and guidance after later source refactors.
additional_context: The Jira-linked 2017 Zulip thread discusses the same negative-finding risk and supports examples/guidance rather than a modifier flag. Observation is active in the current build via source/fhir.ini. Later FHIR-50850 refined the Observation.code comment in 2025 without reversing the FHIR-13318 code/value-pair guidance. Direct Confluence searches found no conflicting records.
reconciliation: No source change was made. Current source includes Observation/vomiting with SNOMED 249497008 and value Absent 2667000, Observation/secondsmoke with a yes qualifier, Observation/abdo-tender using the pattern-3 finding/value approach, and Observation.code / Observation notes guidance requiring code-value pairs to be interpreted together.
